title: The Journal of John Woolman
author: John Woolman
description: The Quaker abolitionist’s journal traces his spiritual life and opposition to slavery. The edition also includes his related writings.
editionNote: Project Gutenberg’s The Journal of John Woolman, with Other Writings. The journal was first published posthumously in 1774.
